ticket.title: In Redis mode platform-settings expires 24 h after the last admin write, which erases every connector allow-list

repo.test_runner: vitest (run one file with `npx vitest run <file>` from Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway; setupFiles ./vitest.setup.ts)
repo.typescript: strict, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, esModuleInterop, module commonjs, target ES2022; the product file's imports at the tip are: import Redis from 'ioredis'; | import { logger } from '../utils/logger';

sites.note: (correct) `if (isRedisAvailable()) {` — the Redis-mode branch of `setNotificationSettings`. Stays, as your leading context line.

**must change** `await redisClient!.setex(fullKey, TTL.privacy, JSON.stringify(data));` — the 24 h write. This is the ONE line you remove. NOTE: this exact text also occurs at `:350` in a different function; yours is the one at **683**, and the trailing context below pins it.
(correct) `} else {` — the in-memory fallback. Stays, as trailing context.

(correct) `notificationSettingsStore.set(key, data);` — the fallback write; unchanged and untouched by this ticket. Stays, as trailing context. This line occurs exactly ONCE in the file and is what makes your hunk land at 683 and not at 350.

expected_plus: // KS-1233: platform-settings is CONFIGURATION, not a cache entry. Written with TTL.privacy it vanished 24 h after the last admin write and every connector allow-list then read as "no restriction" (fail open).
defect_line.sites_rule: every site with must_change=true MUST be changed by the product hunk (its text appears as a '-' line); the checker refuses a diff that leaves one untouched (A3b) before any test runs; sites with key=line+text are matched by LINE NUMBER: the '-' line must be the file's line AT that number (several sites share the same text, so editing one copy does not satisfy another)
red_cells: 🔴 an admin write of platform-settings is stored with NO expiry
